triggerReasons.message: High-risk or gate/security wording selects high-assurance intent hardening.
High-assurance work requires an independent intent-collision result.
Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: In a hermetic main-plus-linked-worktree reproduction, stale global validate exits before any handler or command execution and prints the exact local rerun command; the same command through node bin/lattice.js succeeds and external consumers are unaffected.
acceptanceBindings.note: Binds the user-visible fail-fast, zero-dispatch, local-success, and external-compatibility claim to all three implementation slices.

note: Runtime entrypoint authority acceptance is complete only when detection, diagnostic recovery, and hermetic controls pass together.
